title: Human mental states have no intrinsic intentionality either

statements.text: Against Searle, the right strategy is not to upgrade the simulation until it earns intrinsic intentionality, but to argue that human mental states are as innocent of intrinsic intentionality as the states of any machine simulation. Searle's criticism of functionalism is in error.

sources.quote: As we see it, this criticism of functionalism is profoundly in error.
our own mental states are just as innocent of "intrinsic intentionality" as are the states of any machine simulation
